# Merge notification: 06-client-identity on main (D21)

Held by the orchestration lead. Mission 02's wave_review packet (qitem-20261004002455-b7ea811b,
review-agent) parks on this row so it wakes when the refactor slice is merged, not at every step of the
slice's own workflow (instance 01M425CY9Z4K03G14Y677AT0PA).

Closed by the lead at 06-client-identity's integrate, with the merge SHA, the accepted candidate and the
fresh gate log in the closure note. If the slice is stopped or re-planned instead, the closure says so and
names what the wave review should do.
summary: Merge notification: 06-client-identity merged to main (mission 02 wave_review parks here)
